messages:
zoe: Quick design spike: thinking about variant badges in the canary list. Current badges are color-only (green/orange/red) + tiny text. Concern: color-dependent meaning + cramped on mobile. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/img/variant-badges-v1.png

marta: +1 we should avoid color-only semantics. Proposal: add shape + short label (e.g., P for primary, C for canary, B for baseline) and move the full label into the aria-label/tooltip. Keep visual badge minimal but include a 1px stroke to help contrast.

rory: For keyboard users, moving between variants is clunky. Right now it's drag handle only (mouse). We should support up/down arrow to reorder focusable variants and provide an explicit "Promote" action. Keyboard shortcut idea: when a variant has focus, Enter opens the action menu, and Shift+ArrowUp promotes one step. Needs clear announce.

aria: Accessibility notes: don't rely on single-letter badges alone for SRs. The visible P/C/B is fine visually but ensure aria-label="Primary variant: checkout-service v2" on the badge element. For colorblindness, test in Deutan/Protan/Tritan sims (Color Oracle). Use patterns: shape (dot/diamond/square) + text. Also ensure focus ring around badge meets 3:1 at minimum for small interactive elements.

zoe: I mocked three options: A) shape + narrow label B) full word label (Primary/Canary/Baseline) but larger layout cost C) icon + tooltip only (compact). Thoughts: prefer A for density and clarity.

sam: Copy question: "Promote" vs "Set as primary" vs "Make primary". I prefer "Promote to primary" in the action menu because it's clear that variants are being moved up. Inline CTA on a variant could be "Promote" to save space.

marta: Implementation constraint: our list virtualization reuses DOM nodes; adding many aria-label changes can be tricky. We'll generate aria-labels on render and ensure unique IDs for each label. Rory, can you add a live-region announce when promotion completes: "Variant checkout-service v2 promoted to primary"?

rory: Yup. Also we'll debounce rapid promotions and ensure the reorder animation is reduced when prefers-reduced-motion is set. For keyboard reordering we'll implement roving tabindex pattern and expose aria-grabbed during active drag via keyboard commands.

aria: A few microcopy/accessibility specifics: tooltip text should include service and version, e.g., "Canary — checkout-service v2 (10% traffic)". For SR announcement when focusing badge: "Canary variant, checkout-service v2, 10% traffic. Actions: Promote, Promote to top, Remove." Keep the action verbs consistent.

zoe: Mobile layout: badges should collapse to an icon + 2-char label (e.g., "C10" for canary 10%). On tap open the variant detail sheet with full actions. Avoid tiny touch targets in the list.

sam: UX edge case: when there are many variants (8+), the badge density will kill contrast. Suggest introducing a compressed mode with a single stacked icon and an overflow menu "+3" showing the rest. In compressed mode make the first three variants visible.

aria: Color palette: propose using Color Safe pairings from our design tokens: --badge-primary-bg: #0B6E4F, --badge-canary-bg: #C47C00, --badge-baseline-bg: #6C6F72 with shapes: circle/diamond/square. Verify 4.5:1 contrast for text on each bg for AA small text if possible; otherwise use bold smallcaps to reach effective contrast.

marta: Visual tweak: add a 2px outline on hover/focus that follows WCAG for 3:1 contrast against surrounding UI. Also ensure the badge doesn't clip when service names are long: use truncation with tooltip on hover/focus.

rory: I'll prototype keyboard reorder + roving tabindex and wire telemetry: events for promote, promote-to-top, and compressed-mode-toggle. Also add event when a user uses keyboard shortcut for reorder.

zoe: Can we run Color Oracle + Axe on the prototype? aria: I can run serial SR passes with VoiceOver and NVDA. Also want a quick user test with two colorblind users if possible.

a11y-bot: A11y checklist updated by @aria: add colorblind sims, roving-tabindex, live-region announcements, tooltip SR text, prefers-reduced-motion handling. See https://redwood.internal/checklists/variant-badges-a11y

sam: Final microcopy picks: inline CTA = "Promote", menu = "Promote to primary", tooltip suffix for canary = "(10% traffic)". We'll review after prototype.

marta: Plan: zoe will upload 3 compressed + expanded comps by tomorrow, rory will spike keyboard reorder PR on a feature branch, aria + a11y-bot run checks, sam will finalize microcopy. ETA: Fri EOD for first validated pass.

zoe: Thanks team! I'll post PNGs and a small Loom walkthrough when comps are ready :slightly_smiling_face:
